visibility.notice: Hiding your startup will only remove it from the public leaderboard and searches. Your metrics and settings will NOT be deleted.
visibility.modal_hide_title: Hide this startup from the leaderboard?
visibility.modal_hide_desc: Your startup will no longer appear on Facto's public list or search results. All your metrics, payment data, and configuration will remain safe, and you can republish at any time.
visibility.modal_publish_desc: Your startup will become visible immediately on the public leaderboard and its profile will be accessible to all visitors.

mrr_section.title: Revenue & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
mrr_section.subtitle: Connect your payment gateway to certify revenue in the leaderboard or choose to hide it.
mrr_section.hide_mrr_label: Hide MRR from leaderboard and public profile
mrr_section.hide_mrr_desc: When hidden, your startup will appear without revenue numbers at the bottom of the ranking, keeping your data private.
mrr_section.stripe_help: Use a Restricted Key with read permissions for Charges and Subscriptions.
mrr_section.mp_help: Use your production Access Token from Mercado Pago.
mrr_section.whop_help: Use your Whop developer API Key.

ads.hide_ads_desc: As an advertiser or verified member of Facto, you can toggle header and footer ads on or off across the entire platform.
ads.ad_free_desc: Remove all ads and banners from the ranking permanently for a single payment of $10 USD. No subscriptions or recurring fees.
ads.empty_title: You don't have registered ads yet
ads.empty_desc: Feature your product or startup in the 20 sticky header slots on Facto and drive qualified direct traffic.
ads.alt_email_title: Did you purchase your ad with another email address?
ads.alt_email_desc: If you registered your startup with one email but paid for your ad on Whop with another, no worries: enter your other email here to search and manage your ad slots.
ads.verify_title: Link purchases made with another email
ads.verify_desc: If you purchased your ads or the ad-free pass on Whop with a different email address than this session, enter it here to verify and sync your purchases with your account.
ads.toast_checkout_error: Failed to connect to the payment gateway.
ads.toast_ad_free_success: $10 USD payment completed! Ads have been permanently disabled.
